review_type: Codex agent partial current-source same-scene inspection; not human/child/owner approval

axes.observation: The corner control is a regular near-circle with a uniform dark-purple outline. The painted castle, trees and equipment have varied silhouettes and local surface contours; shared purple alone does not establish congruency.

The control has a nearly uniform pale-lavender fill and soft offset shadow. The neighboring castle shows masonry bands and highlights; the pause panel and its buttons repeat the same flat UI material. This is current source debt, not an accepted repair.
Lavender and dark purple relate to castle roof/wall colors and the pause controls. Native source RGB is retained; no palette change or whole-game palette acceptance is proposed.
The UI shadow reads as a detached interface surface. Scene painting has local modeled highlights; the UI lacks matching painted material bands. No relighting or source-pixel edits were made.
The button stays screen-facing at a fixed corner while the game scene extends in depth. A repair should retain this interface role and avoid implying a physical prop attached to the scenery.
112x112 at (18,18) is unchanged at both tested widths. The same target is above the 110px guideline; exact phone scale/readability and other aspect ratios remain unverified.

This is a floating interface control, so ground contact is not applicable. The existing ownership, touch center and pause/resume transition work in the bounded sequence; preserve that functional geometry.

The control covers sky in the viewed play states and remains above the dimmed pause panel at layer 29. No important object is covered in these four views; that does not close all scenes or other navigation routes.

Menu and return-arrow symbols are visibly distinct in the four viewed frames. Recognition by a non-reader and packaged fallback coverage have not been established. The text-heavy neighboring pause panel remains separate open inventory.

Original corner touch opens pause, changes Menu to Back and resumes to Menu on the same instance. Every visible snapshot still reports normal draw mode 0; the other five authored styles were read from resources but not visibly exercised.

reuse_inventory_status: No new candidate chosen. Published R33 menu-material and R34 focus-repair trials reused a painted wardrobe card for eight StartMenu controls, not this corner control. Recheck those exact sources against the R84 112px Menu/Back control and all remaining states before selecting a repair. Context publication precedes candidate selection.
